question: Are there recruiting trials of empagliflozin in chronic kidney disease, and what are its contraindications?

route.reason: The question asks for recruiting trials of empagliflozin in chronic kidney disease (trial registry) and its contraindications (drug label).

draft.text: Yes. The registry count shows 13 recruiting ClinicalTrials.gov studies of empagliflozin in chronic kidney disease [count:2]. Examples with empagliflozin as an intervention: NCT07074418, Effect of Empagliflozin in Patients With eGFR Between 10 and 20 ml/Min/1.73m2, Phase 4, recruiting [trial:NCT07074418]; NCT06013865, Empagliflozin Treatment in Kidney Transplant Recipients, Phase 4, recruiting [trial:NCT06013865]; NCT06430684, Feasibility Trial of SGLT2 Inhibitors in Pediatric CKD, Early Phase 1, recruiting [trial:NCT06430684]; NCT06642272, Pragmatic Trial Comparing Empagliflozin and Dapagliflozin, Phase 4, recruiting [trial:NCT06642272]. Other recruiting trials in the evidence involve dialysis or end-stage kidney disease, such as NCT05786443, Safety and Efficacy of Empagliflozin in Hemodialysis, Phase 2 [trial:NCT05786443]. Only 10 trials were listed in the evidence, so the full set of 13 is not shown. Contraindication: the label lists only hypersensitivity to empagliflozin or any excipients in JARDIANCE, with reactions such as angioedema having occurred [label:empagliflozin:contraindications:0].
